title: Captain Bob's Boat Rentals
specs: Must be at least 21 years old
Must provide government issued photo ID and credit card in the same name
Credit card pre-authorization deposit required: $1000 for 12 and 14 person boats, $1500 for 15 and 16 person boats
No debit cards or Apple Pay accepted for deposit
Maximum capacities set by federal laws
No extra passengers or pets allowed; contract voided with no refund if violated
Parking: 2 vehicles for 12 and 14 person boats, 3 vehicles for 15 and 16 person boats; $15 per additional vehicle
gap: Exact boat sizes and capacities not listed
blurb: Rent pontoon boats for a full day from 8 AM to 5 PM. Boats have maximum capacities set by federal laws. Gas is not included in the rental rate.
extraNote: Cancel prior to 30 days: refund minus $200 service fee per boat · Cancel within 30 days or no show: no refund, full payment forfeited · No refunds for poor weather, early returns; rain checks only · Rain checks must be claimed in person by 1 PM on rental day · Late returns charged $250 per hour for 12 person boats and up · Boats cannot be operated after dusk; doing so voids contract with no refund · Office at the dock (guests must come in person for rain checks)
